blocks.heading: Powers and duties of the Office of the Royal Society
paragraphs: The Office of the Royal Society has the following powers and duties

list.title: Research and dissemination
list.text: (1) To research and advance all branches of knowledge, and disseminate the resulting works for the benefit of the country and the people

list.title: Knowledge exchange and academic cooperation
list.text: (2) To exchange knowledge and coordinate academically with academies and other academic institutions in Thailand and abroad

list.title: Academic advice to the government
list.text: (3) To provide academic opinions, recommendations and advice to the Prime Minister or the Council of Ministers

list.title: Education, training and academic development
list.text: (4) To provide education, training and academic development in the Thai language, Thai dialects and the fields of study under Section 10, and to award higher diplomas, diplomas, certificates of achievement and certificates to those who complete such education, training and academic development, in accordance with the rules of the Royal Society of Thailand

list.title: Academic services
list.text: (5) To provide academic services to government agencies, state enterprises, independent constitutional bodies, public organizations, other state agencies, educational institutions, private organizations and the public

list.title: Dictionaries and technical terms
list.text: (6) To carry out work on compiling dictionaries, encyclopedias, orthographic dictionaries and taxonomies, coining technical terms in various fields, including compiling dictionaries of foreign-language technical terms in Thai, and other academic work

list.title: Preserving and promoting Thai
list.text: (7) To set guidelines on the use of the Thai language, to preserve the Thai language from deterioration, and to promote the Thai language as a national identity so that it is more prominent

list.title: Promoting translation
list.text: (8) To promote and support the translation of all branches of knowledge from other languages into Thai or from Thai into other languages

list.title: Welfare for Royal Society members
list.text: (9) To provide welfare, assistance and other benefits to members of the Royal Society of Thailand, in accordance with the regulations of the Royal Society of Thailand

list.title: Other duties under the law
list.text: (10) To perform other acts prescribed by law as the powers and duties of the Office of the Royal Society

blocks.heading: Internal units
paragraphs: The missions and responsibilities of each internal unit are awaiting information from the Office of the Royal Society
